US-M1-001
P0 8 pts Employee Records HR Manager

As an HR Manager, I want to create bilingual employee profiles with employment type so that I have an authoritative single source of truth for every person Egybell employs.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Core HRIS capability by enabling HR Managers to to create bilingual employee profiles with employment type. It is a P0 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 1 — Foundation.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Manager (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 1 — Core HRIS — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Core HRIS → Employee Records
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Manager, I want to create bilingual employee profiles with employment t…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given I click New Employee, a multi-step form with Personal, Employment, Compensation, and Documents sections appears
  • When I submit without Arabic or English name, the form blocks submission and highlights missing fields
  • When I select Outsourced employment type, assignment client and period fields become required
  • When I submit a valid profile, the record receives a unique Employee ID, appears in the directory, and an audit event is logged
  • Given a tenant with Module 1 enabled, when an authorized HR Manager performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Manager on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M1-003
P0 8 pts Org Structure HR Director

As an HR Director, I want to model the company organizational structure with departments, cost centers, and reporting lines so that every employee has a clear place in the hierarchy.

US-M1-004
P0 5 pts Self-Service Outsourced Employee

As an Outsourced Employee, I want to view and update my personal contact information in self-service so that HR always has my current address, phone, and emergency contact.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Core HRIS capability by enabling Outsourced Employees to to view and update my personal contact information in self-service. It is a P0 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 1 — Foundation.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Outsourced Employee (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 1 — Core HRIS — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Core HRIS → Self-Service
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an Outsourced Employee, I want to view and update my personal contact informa…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given I open My Profile, I see my current contact details in read mode
  • When I click Edit, I can modify phone, address, and emergency contact fields
  • When I submit changes, the update is staged and HR receives a notification to review
  • Given HR approval, changes are applied and I receive a confirmation
  • Given a tenant with Module 1 enabled, when an authorized Outsourced Employee performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Outsourced Employee on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M1-007
P0 3 pts Time Off Outsourced Employee

As an Outsourced Employee, I want to submit a leave request with type, dates, and optional attachment so that I can take time off through the system instead of email.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Core HRIS capability by enabling Outsourced Employees to to submit a leave request with type, dates, and optional attachment. It is a P0 priority item sized at 3 story points and scheduled within Phase 1 — Foundation.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Outsourced Employee (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 1 — Core HRIS — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Core HRIS → Time Off
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an Outsourced Employee, I want to submit a leave request with type, dates, an…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given I open Request Leave, I see my current balances per leave type
  • When I select dates that exceed my balance, the form warns and blocks submission
  • When I submit, my manager is notified immediately via in-app and email
  • Given approval, the leave appears on my calendar and payroll is informed
  • Given a tenant with Module 1 enabled, when an authorized Outsourced Employee performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Outsourced Employee on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M1-010
P1 5 pts Data Quality HR Director

As an HR Director, I want an employee data quality dashboard so that I can see missing fields, expiring documents, and duplicate records at a glance.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Core HRIS capability by enabling HR Directors to an employee data quality dashboard. It is a P1 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 1 — Foundation.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Director (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 1 — Core HRIS — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Core HRIS → Data Quality
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Director, I want an employee data quality dashboard so that I can see m…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given I open the dashboard, I see KPIs for completeness, expiring docs, and duplicates
  • When I click a KPI, I drill into the affected records
  • When I assign a fix task, it appears in the owner\'s queue
  • Given the records are fixed, the KPI refreshes within 5 minutes
  • Given a tenant with Module 1 enabled, when an authorized HR Director performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Director on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M1-013
P0 3 pts Directory All Employees

As any Employee, I want to search the company directory by name, department, or client so that I can find colleagues quickly.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Core HRIS capability by enabling All Employeess to to search the company directory by name, department, or client. It is a P0 priority item sized at 3 story points and scheduled within Phase 1 — Foundation.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for All Employees (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 1 — Core HRIS — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Core HRIS → Directory
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As any Employee, I want to search the company directory by name, department, or …)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given I type in the search, I see live results with name, role, department, and photo
  • When I click a person, I see their public profile with contact information
  • When I search for an outsourced employee, their client assignment is hidden from non-privileged users
  • Given results exceed 50, pagination is applied
  • Given a tenant with Module 1 enabled, when an authorized All Employees performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to All Employees on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

M2 · Recruitment & ATS

15 stories · 88 pts

US-M2-001
P0 5 pts Requisitions Hiring Manager

As a Hiring Manager, I want to raise a job requisition with role, headcount, budget, and justification so that recruiting work only starts after proper approval.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Recruitment & ATS capability by enabling Hiring Managers to to raise a job requisition with role, headcount, budget, and justification. It is a P0 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Hiring Manager (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 2 — Recruitment & ATS — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Recruitment & ATS → Requisitions
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Hiring Manager, I want to raise a job requisition with role, headcount, bud…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given I click New Requisition, I see a form with role template, headcount, budget, and client assignment
  • When I submit, the requisition routes through the approval chain defined for the cost center
  • When fully approved, the job is made available to Recruiters
  • Given rejection, I see the reason and can edit and resubmit
  • Given a tenant with Module 2 enabled, when an authorized Hiring Manager performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Hiring Manager on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M2-004
P0 5 pts Pipeline Recruiter

As a Recruiter, I want a kanban pipeline for each requisition with stages (New, Screen, Interview, Offer, Hire) so that I can track candidates visually.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Recruitment & ATS capability by enabling Recruiters to a kanban pipeline for each requisition with stages (New, Screen, Interview, Offer, Hire). It is a P0 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Recruiter (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 2 — Recruitment & ATS — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Recruitment & ATS → Pipeline
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Recruiter, I want a kanban pipeline for each requisition with stages (New, …)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given a job, I see a drag-and-drop kanban board with configurable stages
  • When I move a candidate to Interview, interview scheduling is triggered
  • When I reject, I must capture reason code for reporting
  • Given stage SLAs, overdue candidates are highlighted
  • Given a tenant with Module 2 enabled, when an authorized Recruiter performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Recruiter on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M2-007
P0 5 pts Interviewing Interviewer

As an Interviewer, I want a structured scorecard per competency so that my feedback is consistent with other interviewers.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Recruitment & ATS capability by enabling Interviewers to a structured scorecard per competency. It is a P0 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Interviewer (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 2 — Recruitment & ATS — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Recruitment & ATS → Interviewing
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an Interviewer, I want a structured scorecard per competency so that my feedb…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given an assigned interview, I see a scorecard with role competencies and rating scale
  • When I submit, the feedback is visible only to the panel and hiring manager
  • When I am late, I receive reminders
  • Given panel complete, an aggregate score is computed
  • Given a tenant with Module 2 enabled, when an authorized Interviewer performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Interviewer on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M2-010
P1 5 pts Talent Pool Recruiter

As a Recruiter, I want to build searchable talent pools from past applicants so that I can re-engage silver-medalists for future roles.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Recruitment & ATS capability by enabling Recruiters to to build searchable talent pools from past applicants. It is a P1 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Recruiter (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 2 — Recruitment & ATS — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Recruitment & ATS → Talent Pool
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Recruiter, I want to build searchable talent pools from past applicants so …)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given a candidate, I can tag them with skills, location, and availability
  • When I search the pool, I can filter by any tag
  • When a candidate opts out, they are removed from searches
  • Given GDPR/PDPL retention limits, expired profiles are purged automatically
  • Given a tenant with Module 2 enabled, when an authorized Recruiter performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Recruiter on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M2-013
P1 3 pts Analytics Recruiter

As a Recruiter, I want funnel metrics (time-to-fill, source of hire, conversion) per job so that I can improve my own performance.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Recruitment & ATS capability by enabling Recruiters to funnel metrics (time-to-fill, source of hire, conversion) per job. It is a P1 priority item sized at 3 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Recruiter (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 2 — Recruitment & ATS — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Recruitment & ATS → Analytics
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Recruiter, I want funnel metrics (time-to-fill, source of hire, conversion)…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given a closed job, I see the funnel visualization
  • When I compare periods, I can benchmark against my history
  • When I filter by source, I see source ROI
  • Given incomplete data, the metric is shown with a warning
  • Given a tenant with Module 2 enabled, when an authorized Recruiter performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Recruiter on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

M3 · Onboarding & Offboarding

15 stories · 80 pts

US-M3-001
P0 8 pts Onboarding Plan HR Specialist

As an HR Specialist, I want to trigger an onboarding plan automatically when an offer is accepted so that nothing is forgotten before Day 1.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Onboarding & Offboarding capability by enabling HR Specialists to to trigger an onboarding plan automatically when an offer is accepted. It is a P0 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Specialist (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 3 — Onboarding & Offboarding — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Onboarding & Offboarding → Onboarding Plan
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Specialist, I want to trigger an onboarding plan automatically when an …)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given an accepted offer, a plan based on role template is instantiated
  • When a task owner is assigned, they receive a notification
  • When a task is overdue, it escalates to HR Manager
  • Given all Day 1 tasks complete, the employee status becomes Active
  • Given a tenant with Module 3 enabled, when an authorized HR Specialist performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Specialist on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M3-004
P1 5 pts Orientation HR Specialist

As an HR Specialist, I want to schedule orientation sessions and track attendance so that every new hire completes mandatory training.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Onboarding & Offboarding capability by enabling HR Specialists to to schedule orientation sessions and track attendance. It is a P1 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Specialist (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 3 — Onboarding & Offboarding — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Onboarding & Offboarding → Orientation
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Specialist, I want to schedule orientation sessions and track attendanc…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given weekly cohorts, orientation is auto-scheduled
  • When attendance is captured, it posts to the employee\'s training record
  • When absent, a makeup session is auto-booked
  • Given completion, a certificate is stored in the document vault
  • Given a tenant with Module 3 enabled, when an authorized HR Specialist performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Specialist on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given a new hire, check-in tasks appear in my queue
  • When I complete a check-in, feedback is saved to the employee record
  • When 90 days pass without confirmation, HR is alerted
  • Given a decision, the lifecycle event is logged
  • Given a tenant with Module 3 enabled, when an authorized Line Manager performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Line Manager on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage
