US-M3-009
P0 5 pts Client Handoff Client SPOC

As a Client SPOC, I want visibility into onboarding progress for my assigned outsourced employees so that I know when they will be fully productive.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Onboarding & Offboarding capability by enabling Client SPOCs to visibility into onboarding progress for my assigned outsourced employees. It is a P0 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Client SPOC (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 3 — Onboarding & Offboarding — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Onboarding & Offboarding → Client Handoff
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Client SPOC, I want visibility into onboarding progress for my assigned out…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given my client has new hires, I see their status and estimated ready date
  • When blocked, I am notified of the reason
  • When complete, I confirm readiness to take them on
  • Given privacy, I only see roles and status, not personal data
  • Given a tenant with Module 3 enabled, when an authorized Client SPOC performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Client SPOC on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M3-012
P1 5 pts Exit Interview HR Specialist

As an HR Specialist, I want structured exit interviews with sentiment analysis so that I learn from every departure.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Onboarding & Offboarding capability by enabling HR Specialists to structured exit interviews with sentiment analysis. It is a P1 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Specialist (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 3 — Onboarding & Offboarding — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Onboarding & Offboarding → Exit Interview
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Specialist, I want structured exit interviews with sentiment analysis s…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given an exit, I send an anonymous survey link
  • When submitted, sentiment and themes are tagged
  • When themes trend negatively, they appear on the HR dashboard
  • Given PDPL, individual responses are not linked to identity after 30 days
  • Given a tenant with Module 3 enabled, when an authorized HR Specialist performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Specialist on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M3-015
P0 8 pts Compliance Docs HR Specialist

As an HR Specialist, I want mandatory Egyptian Labor Law documents (Form 1, Form 6) generated and filed automatically so that every hire and exit is compliant.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Onboarding & Offboarding capability by enabling HR Specialists to mandatory Egyptian Labor Law documents (Form 1, Form 6) generated and filed automatically. It is a P0 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Specialist (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 3 — Onboarding & Offboarding — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Onboarding & Offboarding → Compliance Docs
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Specialist, I want mandatory Egyptian Labor Law documents (Form 1, Form…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given a new hire, Form 1 is generated and signed digitally
  • When filed with social insurance, the confirmation number is stored
  • When an exit occurs, Form 6 is generated with calculated settlement
  • Given audit, the full document trail is exportable
  • Given a tenant with Module 3 enabled, when an authorized HR Specialist performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Specialist on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M4-003
P0 5 pts KPI Tracking Outsourced Employee

As an Outsourced Employee, I want to log weekly progress against KPIs in under 2 minutes so that my manager has visibility without calling me.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Performance & KPIs capability by enabling Outsourced Employees to to log weekly progress against KPIs in under 2 minutes. It is a P0 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Outsourced Employee (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 4 — Performance & KPIs — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Performance & KPIs → KPI Tracking
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an Outsourced Employee, I want to log weekly progress against KPIs in under 2…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given a KPI, I enter the current value and a note
  • When auto-computable, the value is pulled from source systems
  • When I miss a week, I get a reminder
  • Given submitted, manager sees real-time update
  • Given a tenant with Module 4 enabled, when an authorized Outsourced Employee performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Outsourced Employee on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M4-006
P2 8 pts 360 Feedback HR Specialist

As an HR Specialist, I want to run 360 feedback cycles with configurable reviewer selection so that leaders get well-rounded input.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Performance & KPIs capability by enabling HR Specialists to to run 360 feedback cycles with configurable reviewer selection. It is a P2 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Specialist (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 4 — Performance & KPIs — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Performance & KPIs → 360 Feedback
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Specialist, I want to run 360 feedback cycles with configurable reviewe…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given a cycle, I configure questions and minimum reviewers
  • When reviewers are nominated, they have 14 days to respond
  • When responses are submitted, anonymization removes identity
  • Given threshold met, the leader sees the aggregated report
  • Given a tenant with Module 4 enabled, when an authorized HR Specialist performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Specialist on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M4-009
P1 5 pts Performance Improvement Line Manager

As a Line Manager, I want to start a performance improvement plan (PIP) for underperformers with clear milestones so that there is a fair process.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Performance & KPIs capability by enabling Line Managers to to start a performance improvement plan (PIP) for underperformers with clear milestones. It is a P1 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Line Manager (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 4 — Performance & KPIs — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Performance & KPIs → Performance Improvement
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Line Manager, I want to start a performance improvement plan (PIP) for unde…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given low rating, I can initiate a PIP template
  • When employee acknowledges, the plan becomes active
  • When milestones are missed, HR is alerted
  • Given completion, outcome (return to good standing, exit) is logged
  • Given a tenant with Module 4 enabled, when an authorized Line Manager performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Line Manager on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M4-012
P0 8 pts Client KPIs Client SPOC

As a Client SPOC, I want to set and review KPIs for my outsourced team so that I can confirm they meet my service levels.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Performance & KPIs capability by enabling Client SPOCs to to set and review KPIs for my outsourced team. It is a P0 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Client SPOC (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 4 — Performance & KPIs — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Performance & KPIs → Client KPIs
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Client SPOC, I want to set and review KPIs for my outsourced team so that I…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given my contract, I define KPIs and thresholds
  • When data flows in, dashboards update
  • When SLA breached, I am notified
  • Given monthly close, I approve KPI results for billing
  • Given a tenant with Module 4 enabled, when an authorized Client SPOC performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Client SPOC on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M4-015
P1 8 pts Compensation Link HR Manager

As an HR Manager, I want performance ratings to feed merit increase recommendations so that pay decisions reflect performance.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Performance & KPIs capability by enabling HR Managers to performance ratings to feed merit increase recommendations. It is a P1 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Manager (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 4 — Performance & KPIs — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Performance & KPIs → Compensation Link
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Manager, I want performance ratings to feed merit increase recommendati…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given ratings, the comp module generates recommended increases
  • When I override, justification is required
  • When finalized, payroll receives new base salaries
  • Given budget overrun, the system blocks submission
  • Given a tenant with Module 4 enabled, when an authorized HR Manager performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Manager on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M5-003
P0 8 pts Compliance Training HR Specialist

As an HR Specialist, I want mandatory compliance courses assigned automatically with deadlines so that the company stays audit-ready.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Training & LMS capability by enabling HR Specialists to mandatory compliance courses assigned automatically with deadlines. It is a P0 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Specialist (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 5 — Training & LMS — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Training & LMS → Compliance Training
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Specialist, I want mandatory compliance courses assigned automatically …)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given a role, mandatory courses are auto-assigned
  • When a deadline is near, reminders escalate
  • When overdue, access to some systems is revoked
  • Given all compliant, a proof of compliance report is available
  • Given a tenant with Module 5 enabled, when an authorized HR Specialist performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Specialist on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M5-006
P1 5 pts Certifications HR Manager

As an HR Manager, I want to track industry certifications with expiry alerts so that our workforce qualifications remain current.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Training & LMS capability by enabling HR Managers to to track industry certifications with expiry alerts. It is a P1 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Manager (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 5 — Training & LMS — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Training & LMS → Certifications
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Manager, I want to track industry certifications with expiry alerts so …)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given a cert, I log issue date, expiry, and upload evidence
  • When expiry nears, the employee is reminded
  • When expired, the skill is removed from profile
  • Given renewal, new expiry is tracked
  • Given a tenant with Module 5 enabled, when an authorized HR Manager performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Manager on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M5-009
P2 8 pts Mobile Learning Outsourced Employee

As an Outsourced Employee, I want to complete microlearning on mobile with offline support so that I can learn during commute or downtime.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Training & LMS capability by enabling Outsourced Employees to to complete microlearning on mobile with offline support. It is a P2 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Outsourced Employee (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 5 — Training & LMS — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Training & LMS → Mobile Learning
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an Outsourced Employee, I want to complete microlearning on mobile with offli…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given mobile login, I see my assigned courses
  • When offline, I can consume downloaded content
  • When back online, progress syncs
  • Given completion, certificate is downloadable
  • Given a tenant with Module 5 enabled, when an authorized Outsourced Employee performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Outsourced Employee on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Manager on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M5-012
P1 8 pts Client-Specific Training Client SPOC

As a Client SPOC, I want to assign client-specific onboarding training to my outsourced team so that they understand my processes before starting.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Training & LMS capability by enabling Client SPOCs to to assign client-specific onboarding training to my outsourced team. It is a P1 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Client SPOC (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 5 — Training & LMS — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Training & LMS → Client-Specific Training
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Client SPOC, I want to assign client-specific onboarding training to my out…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given my team, I upload training materials
  • When assigned, employees get notified with deadline
  • When complete, I see confirmation and score
  • Given audit, completion records are exportable
  • Given a tenant with Module 5 enabled, when an authorized Client SPOC performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Client SPOC on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Training & LMS capability by enabling Learners to to rate courses and leave feedback. It is a P2 priority item sized at 3 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Training & LMS → Feedback
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Learner, I want to rate courses and leave feedback so that content improves…)

  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given course complete, a rating form appears
  • When submitted, it aggregates on course detail
  • When below threshold, Training Lead is alerted
  • Given open text, moderation prevents abuse
  • Given a tenant with Module 5 enabled, when an authorized Learner performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Learner on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M5-015

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Training & LMS capability by enabling Training Leads to to integrate Coursera/LinkedIn Learning content. It is a P2 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Training Lead (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 5 — Training & LMS — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Training & LMS → Integration

  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
