  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given gross salary, progressive brackets are applied
  • When there are allowances, they are correctly excluded/included
  • When tax credits apply, they reduce the liability
  • Given changes in law, admin can update brackets with effective dates
  • Given a tenant with Module 6 enabled, when an authorized Payroll Officer performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Payroll Officer on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given approved overtime, weekday/rest/holiday multipliers apply
  • When attendance is missing, payroll flags the gap
  • When employee is exempt, overtime is zero
  • Given ceiling, hours above ceiling are excluded
  • Given a tenant with Module 6 enabled, when an authorized Payroll Officer performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Payroll Officer on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

  • Given audit, calculation trace is exportable
  • Given a tenant with Module 6 enabled, when an authorized Payroll Officer performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Payroll Officer on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Payroll & Compensation capability by enabling Payroll Officers to automatic variance analysis comparing current to prior run. It is a P1 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 1 — Foundation.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Payroll Officer (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 6 — Payroll & Compensation — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured

  1. User navigates to Payroll & Compensation → Variance Analysis

  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties

  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Director on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

Story Details

Business Context

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Employee (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 6 — Payroll & Compensation — enabled in the license plan

  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Payroll Officer on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M6-015
P0 8 pts Payroll Locks System Admin

As a System Admin, I want segregation-of-duties controls so that no single user can create, approve, and release payroll.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Payroll & Compensation capability by enabling System Admins to segregation-of-duties controls. It is a P0 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 1 — Foundation.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for System Admin (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 6 — Payroll & Compensation — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Payroll & Compensation → Payroll Locks
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a System Admin, I want segregation-of-duties controls so that no single user …)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given roles, create/approve/release are separate
  • When same user attempts two, the system blocks
  • When audit runs, SoD violations are listed
  • Given emergency, dual-approval override is logged
  • Given a tenant with Module 6 enabled, when an authorized System Admin performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

  • When approved, reimbursement flows via payroll
  • Given rejection, reason is explained
  • Given a tenant with Module 7 enabled, when an authorized Employee performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Employee on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M7-003
P1 5 pts Expense Report Employee

As an Employee, I want to submit expense reports with receipts and GL coding so that I am reimbursed quickly.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Benefits & Expenses capability by enabling Employees to to submit expense reports with receipts and GL coding. It is a P1 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Employee (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 7 — Benefits & Expenses — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Benefits & Expenses → Expense Report
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an Employee, I want to submit expense reports with receipts and GL coding so …)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

  • Given expenses, I group them in a report
  • When I submit, my manager reviews with per-line approval
  • When approved, finance sees it in the queue

  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Story Details

Business Context

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Finance Officer (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 7 — Benefits & Expenses — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Benefits & Expenses → Corporate Card
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Finance Officer, I want corporate card transactions imported daily with aut…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given bank feed, transactions import nightly
  • When a receipt exists, matching is automatic
  • When unmatched, cardholder is reminded
  • Given month end, reconciliation report is generated
  • Given a tenant with Module 7 enabled, when an authorized Finance Officer performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Finance Officer on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M7-008
P2 3 pts Mileage Employee

As an Employee, I want to claim mileage with auto-distance from Google Maps so that I don\'t need to measure.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Benefits & Expenses capability by enabling Employees to to claim mileage with auto-distance from Google Maps. It is a P2 priority item sized at 3 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Employee (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 7 — Benefits & Expenses — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Benefits & Expenses → Mileage
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an Employee, I want to claim mileage with auto-distance from Google Maps so t…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given origin and destination, distance auto-populates
  • When rate changes, new distance uses new rate
  • When round trip, multiplier applies
  • Given history, I can reuse common routes
  • Given a tenant with Module 7 enabled, when an authorized Employee performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Employee on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M7-011
P2 5 pts Benefit Cost HR Director

As an HR Director, I want benefit cost analysis by plan and provider so that I can negotiate renewals.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Benefits & Expenses capability by enabling HR Directors to benefit cost analysis by plan and provider. It is a P2 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Director (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 7 — Benefits & Expenses — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Benefits & Expenses → Benefit Cost
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Director, I want benefit cost analysis by plan and provider so that I c…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given enrolled members, monthly cost per plan is visible
  • When plan is changed, projection updates
  • When claim ratio high, alert is raised
  • Given vendor data, actuals vs estimate is compared
  • Given a tenant with Module 7 enabled, when an authorized HR Director performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Director on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M7-014
P2 5 pts Receipt OCR Employee

As an Employee, I want OCR to read receipts so that I don\'t manually type amounts.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Benefits & Expenses capability by enabling Employees to OCR to read receipts. It is a P2 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Employee (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 7 — Benefits & Expenses — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Benefits & Expenses → Receipt OCR
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an Employee, I want OCR to read receipts so that I don\'t manually type amoun…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given upload, OCR extracts date, merchant, amount, tax
  • When confidence is low, user confirms
  • When wrong, I can correct and feedback is captured
  • Given non-Arabic, both languages are supported
  • Given a tenant with Module 7 enabled, when an authorized Employee performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Employee on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years

US-M8-002
P1 8 pts SoW Management Engagement Manager

As an Engagement Manager, I want to manage Statements of Work with milestones and deliverables so that I know when to pay contractors.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Contractor Management capability by enabling Engagement Managers to to manage Statements of Work with milestones and deliverables. It is a P1 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Engagement Manager (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 8 — Contractor Management — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Contractor Management → SoW Management
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an Engagement Manager, I want to manage Statements of Work with milestones an…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given a SoW, I define milestones with dates and amounts
  • When milestone met, I approve payment
  • When overdue, risk is flagged
  • Given change order, a version is kept
  • Given a tenant with Module 8 enabled, when an authorized Engagement Manager performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Engagement Manager on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Contractor on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M8-005
P0 5 pts Compliance Checks Compliance Officer

As a Compliance Officer, I want contractor documents (tax card, CR, insurance) tracked with expiry so that we don\'t pay non-compliant vendors.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Contractor Management capability by enabling Compliance Officers to contractor documents (tax card, CR, insurance) tracked with expiry. It is a P0 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Compliance Officer (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 8 — Contractor Management — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Contractor Management → Compliance Checks
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Compliance Officer, I want contractor documents (tax card, CR, insurance) t…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given upload, expiry is captured
  • When expiry nears, contractor is notified
  • When expired, payments are held
  • Given renewal, holds release
  • Given a tenant with Module 8 enabled, when an authorized Compliance Officer performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix

  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record

  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit

  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given contractor, access is provisioned to listed systems only
  • When SoW ends, access is revoked automatically
  • When extended, access also extends
  • Given audit, current access is always accurate
  • Given a tenant with Module 8 enabled, when an authorized System Admin performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to System Admin on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M8-010
P0 5 pts Tax Withholding Finance Officer

As a Finance Officer, I want correct tax withholding for contractors per Egyptian law so that we remit the right amount.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Contractor Management capability by enabling Finance Officers to correct tax withholding for contractors per Egyptian law. It is a P0 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Finance Officer (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 8 — Contractor Management — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Contractor Management → Tax Withholding
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Finance Officer, I want correct tax withholding for contractors per Egyptia…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given contractor type, withholding rate is set
  • When invoice paid, withholding is captured
  • When certificate requested, it is generated
  • Given tax filing, report is exportable
  • Given a tenant with Module 8 enabled, when an authorized Finance Officer performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Finance Officer on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage
