US-M8-013
P2 5 pts Conversion HR Manager

As an HR Manager, I want to convert a contractor to an employee with history preservation so that we don\'t lose their track record.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Contractor Management capability by enabling HR Managers to to convert a contractor to an employee with history preservation. It is a P2 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 2 — Talent Acquisition.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Manager (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 8 — Contractor Management — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Contractor Management → Conversion
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Manager, I want to convert a contractor to an employee with history pre…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given a contractor, I trigger conversion workflow
  • When offered, accepted offer creates employee record
  • When linked, past engagements show on employee profile
  • Given tax implications, finance reviews
  • Given a tenant with Module 8 enabled, when an authorized HR Manager performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Manager on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

M9 · Analytics & Reporting

15 stories · 102 pts

US-M9-001
P1 8 pts Exec Dashboard HR Director

As an HR Director, I want an executive dashboard with headcount, attrition, cost, and engagement KPIs so that I can brief the CEO in 5 minutes.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Analytics & Reporting capability by enabling HR Directors to an executive dashboard with headcount, attrition, cost, and engagement KPIs. It is a P1 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 4 — Intelligence.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Director (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 9 — Analytics & Reporting — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Analytics & Reporting → Exec Dashboard
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Director, I want an executive dashboard with headcount, attrition, cost…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given data warehouse, KPIs update nightly
  • When I click a KPI, I drill into detail
  • When I compare periods, trends render
  • Given export, PPT-ready visuals are available
  • Given a tenant with Module 9 enabled, when an authorized HR Director performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Director on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M9-004
P0 8 pts Compliance Reports HR Manager

As an HR Manager, I want prebuilt compliance reports (Labor Law, Tax, SI) so that audits are painless.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Analytics & Reporting capability by enabling HR Managers to prebuilt compliance reports (Labor Law, Tax, SI). It is a P0 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 4 — Intelligence.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Manager (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 9 — Analytics & Reporting — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Analytics & Reporting → Compliance Reports
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Manager, I want prebuilt compliance reports (Labor Law, Tax, SI) so tha…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given a report, I pick period and entity
  • When generated, it matches regulatory format
  • When filed, filing reference is stored
  • Given evidence, supporting documents are linked
  • Given a tenant with Module 9 enabled, when an authorized HR Manager performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Manager on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M9-007
P2 8 pts Engagement Survey HR Specialist

As an HR Specialist, I want to run engagement surveys with anonymization and theme analysis so that we understand employee sentiment.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Analytics & Reporting capability by enabling HR Specialists to to run engagement surveys with anonymization and theme analysis. It is a P2 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 4 — Intelligence.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Specialist (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 9 — Analytics & Reporting — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Analytics & Reporting → Engagement Survey
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Specialist, I want to run engagement surveys with anonymization and the…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given a survey, I schedule and send
  • When responses received, anonymity is preserved
  • When theme analysis runs, insights are generated
  • Given action planning, managers get team reports
  • Given a tenant with Module 9 enabled, when an authorized HR Specialist performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Specialist on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M9-010
P1 5 pts Data Export HR Analyst

As an HR Analyst, I want bulk data export to CSV and Excel with scheduling so that I can feed external BI tools.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Analytics & Reporting capability by enabling HR Analysts to bulk data export to CSV and Excel with scheduling. It is a P1 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 4 — Intelligence.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Analyst (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 9 — Analytics & Reporting — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Analytics & Reporting → Data Export
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Analyst, I want bulk data export to CSV and Excel with scheduling so th…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given a report, I schedule weekly export
  • When generated, file is delivered to secure storage
  • When large, chunking is handled transparently
  • Given audit, who exported what is logged
  • Given a tenant with Module 9 enabled, when an authorized HR Analyst performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Analyst on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Director on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M9-013
P2 5 pts Pulse Surveys HR Manager

As an HR Manager, I want quick pulse surveys (3-5 questions) to track morale so that I can act between annual surveys.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Analytics & Reporting capability by enabling HR Managers to quick pulse surveys (3-5 questions) to track morale. It is a P2 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 4 — Intelligence.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for HR Manager (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 9 — Analytics & Reporting — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Analytics & Reporting → Pulse Surveys
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an HR Manager, I want quick pulse surveys (3-5 questions) to track morale so …)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

  • When sent, completion rate tracked
  • When low, managers are nudged
  • Given results, trends are shown

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given a report, I add recipients and schedule
  • When sent, delivery is confirmed
  • When unsubscribed, respect choice
  • Given format, PDF or Excel options
  • Given a tenant with Module 9 enabled, when an authorized HR Manager performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to HR Manager on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M10-004
P0 8 pts Audit Log Compliance Officer

As a Compliance Officer, I want an immutable audit log of all critical actions so that investigations are definitive.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's System Administration capability by enabling Compliance Officers to an immutable audit log of all critical actions. It is a P0 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 1 — Foundation.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Compliance Officer (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 10 — System Administration — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to System Administration → Audit Log
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Compliance Officer, I want an immutable audit log of all critical actions s…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given action, event captures who/what/when/where
  • When I search, I can filter and export
  • When tampered, integrity check fails
  • Given retention, policy determines life
  • Given a tenant with Module 10 enabled, when an authorized Compliance Officer performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Compliance Officer on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M10-007
P1 13 pts Integration Hub Integration Developer

As an Integration Developer, I want an integration hub with connectors, transforms, and error handling so that external systems sync reliably.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's System Administration capability by enabling Integration Developers to an integration hub with connectors, transforms, and error handling. It is a P1 priority item sized at 13 story points and scheduled within Phase 1 — Foundation.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Integration Developer (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 10 — System Administration — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to System Administration → Integration Hub
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an Integration Developer, I want an integration hub with connectors, transfor…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given a connector, I configure source and target
  • When mapping is set, data flows
  • When error, retry and DLQ are handled
  • Given monitoring, job health is visible
  • Given a tenant with Module 10 enabled, when an authorized Integration Developer performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Integration Developer on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M10-011
P0 8 pts Data Retention Compliance Officer

As a Compliance Officer, I want to define data retention policies per entity so that we comply with PDPL.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's System Administration capability by enabling Compliance Officers to to define data retention policies per entity. It is a P0 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 1 — Foundation.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Compliance Officer (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 10 — System Administration — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to System Administration → Data Retention
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Compliance Officer, I want to define data retention policies per entity so …)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given entity, I set retention period
  • When expired, purge job runs with audit
  • When legal hold, purge is skipped
  • Given report, retention status is visible
  • Given a tenant with Module 10 enabled, when an authorized Compliance Officer performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Compliance Officer on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's System Administration capability by enabling Tenant Admins to to apply our logo, colors, and domain to our portal. It is a P1 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 1 — Foundation.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Tenant Admin (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 10 — System Administration — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to System Administration → Branding
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Tenant Admin, I want to apply our logo, colors, and domain to our portal so…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given assets, I upload and preview
  • When saved, portal updates
  • When custom domain, SSL is provisioned
  • Given policy, brand guidelines are enforced
  • Given a tenant with Module 10 enabled, when an authorized Tenant Admin performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Tenant Admin on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Employee on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M11-003
P1 3 pts Payslip Mobile Employee

As an Employee, I want to view and download my payslip on mobile so that I can reference pay on the go.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Mobile App capability by enabling Employees to to view and download my payslip on mobile. It is a P1 priority item sized at 3 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Employee (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 11 — Mobile App — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Mobile App → Payslip Mobile
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an Employee, I want to view and download my payslip on mobile so that I can r…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given pay run, payslip appears in app
  • When I download, it saves to files
  • When offline, previously viewed payslips are cached
  • Given privacy, biometric re-check before opening
  • Given a tenant with Module 11 enabled, when an authorized Employee performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Employee on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage
