US-M11-006
P1 3 pts Approvals Mobile Line Manager

As a Line Manager, I want to approve leave and expenses with one tap from a notification so that my team isn\'t blocked.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Mobile App capability by enabling Line Managers to to approve leave and expenses with one tap from a notification. It is a P1 priority item sized at 3 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Line Manager (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 11 — Mobile App — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Mobile App → Approvals Mobile
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Line Manager, I want to approve leave and expenses with one tap from a noti…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given notification, I tap to open details
  • When I approve, the request moves
  • When I reject, reason is mandatory
  • Given bulk, I can select multiple
  • Given a tenant with Module 11 enabled, when an authorized Line Manager performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Line Manager on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M11-009
P2 8 pts Offline Mode Outsourced Employee

As an Outsourced Employee, I want key actions to work offline so that poor coverage doesn\'t stop me.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Mobile App capability by enabling Outsourced Employees to key actions to work offline. It is a P2 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Outsourced Employee (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 11 — Mobile App — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Mobile App → Offline Mode
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an Outsourced Employee, I want key actions to work offline so that poor cover…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given offline, I can view cached data and queue actions
  • When online, actions sync automatically
  • When conflict, user is prompted
  • Given storage, cache is capped
  • Given a tenant with Module 11 enabled, when an authorized Outsourced Employee performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Outsourced Employee on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M11-012
P2 3 pts Mobile Surveys Employee

As an Employee, I want to respond to pulse surveys in under 60 seconds so that I actually participate.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Mobile App capability by enabling Employees to to respond to pulse surveys in under 60 seconds. It is a P2 priority item sized at 3 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Employee (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 11 — Mobile App — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Mobile App → Mobile Surveys
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As an Employee, I want to respond to pulse surveys in under 60 seconds so that I…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given survey, one question at a time
  • When I swipe, I submit answer
  • When complete, thank-you appears
  • Given anonymity, name is not recorded
  • Given a tenant with Module 11 enabled, when an authorized Employee performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Employee on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M11-015
P2 5 pts App Analytics Product Manager

As a Product Manager, I want mobile usage analytics so that I know what features to invest in.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Mobile App capability by enabling Product Managers to mobile usage analytics. It is a P2 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Product Manager (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 11 — Mobile App — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Mobile App → App Analytics
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Product Manager, I want mobile usage analytics so that I know what features…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given events, dashboards show DAU/MAU
  • When drop-off, funnel identifies step
  • When crash, issue is reported
  • Given privacy, PII is not logged
  • Given a tenant with Module 11 enabled, when an authorized Product Manager performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Product Manager on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M12-003
P0 5 pts Attendance Visibility Client SPOC

As a Client SPOC, I want to see attendance and leave for my outsourced team so that I plan coverage.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Client Portal capability by enabling Client SPOCs to to see attendance and leave for my outsourced team. It is a P0 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Client SPOC (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 12 — Client Portal — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Client Portal → Attendance Visibility
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Client SPOC, I want to see attendance and leave for my outsourced team so t…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given date range, attendance heatmap shows
  • When anomaly, it is highlighted
  • When employee absent, reason is visible
  • Given approval, I can request action from Egybell
  • Given a tenant with Module 12 enabled, when an authorized Client SPOC performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Client SPOC on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M12-006
P0 5 pts Invoicing Client Finance

As a Client Finance user, I want to view and download monthly invoices with backup detail so that I can process payment.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Client Portal capability by enabling Client Finances to to view and download monthly invoices with backup detail. It is a P0 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 3 — Performance & Growth.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Client Finance (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 12 — Client Portal — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Client Portal → Invoicing
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Client Finance user, I want to view and download monthly invoices with back…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given invoice, I can download PDF and Excel
  • When I dispute, ticket is raised
  • When paid, status updates
  • Given credit note, it is linked to invoice
  • Given a tenant with Module 12 enabled, when an authorized Client Finance performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Client Finance on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Client Portal → Reporting
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Client Admin, I want to subscribe to weekly and monthly performance reports…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given preferences, email schedule is set
  • When sent, delivery is confirmed
  • When I unsubscribe, I stop receiving
  • Given format, PDF and Excel are options
  • Given a tenant with Module 12 enabled, when an authorized Client Admin performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Client Admin on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

  • Given assets, logo and color are applied
  • When saved, portal reflects
  • When reset, Praxion defaults return
  • Given policy, co-branding rules enforced
  • Given a tenant with Module 12 enabled, when an authorized Client Admin performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Client Admin on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

Story Details

Business Context

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Client Admin (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 12 — Client Portal — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Client Portal → Insights
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Client Admin, I want insights on turnover, tenure, and skills of my outsour…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry

  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Client Admin at Holding on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

M13 · Billing & Invoicing

15 stories · 120 pts

US-M13-001
P0 8 pts Contract Billing Rules Finance Manager

As a Finance Manager, I want to define billing rules per contract (rate, markup, pass-through) so that invoices reflect agreements.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Billing & Invoicing capability by enabling Finance Managers to to define billing rules per contract (rate, markup, pass-through). It is a P0 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 4 — Intelligence.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Finance Manager (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 13 — Billing & Invoicing — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Billing & Invoicing → Contract Billing Rules
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Finance Manager, I want to define billing rules per contract (rate, markup,…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given contract, I configure rate model
  • When pass-through, actuals flow
  • When markup, percent or fixed applies
  • Given update, new rules apply from effective date
  • Given a tenant with Module 13 enabled, when an authorized Finance Manager performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Finance Manager on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream

  • Audit service — append-only store

  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout

US-M13-004
P0 5 pts Invoice Delivery Billing Officer

As a Billing Officer, I want to deliver invoices to clients via email and portal with read receipts so that disputes don\'t start with \'I didn\'t get it.\'

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Billing & Invoicing capability by enabling Billing Officers to to deliver invoices to clients via email and portal with read receipts. It is a P0 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 4 — Intelligence.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Billing Officer (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 13 — Billing & Invoicing — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Billing & Invoicing → Invoice Delivery
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Billing Officer, I want to deliver invoices to clients via email and portal…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given invoice, I pick channels
  • When sent, delivery is confirmed
  • When opened, read receipt captured
  • Given bounce, alternative channel used
  • Given a tenant with Module 13 enabled, when an authorized Billing Officer performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Billing Officer on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M13-007
P1 5 pts Receivables Finance Manager

As a Finance Manager, I want to track receivables by client with aging so that we collect on time.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Billing & Invoicing capability by enabling Finance Managers to to track receivables by client with aging. It is a P1 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 4 — Intelligence.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Finance Manager (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 13 — Billing & Invoicing — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Billing & Invoicing → Receivables
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Finance Manager, I want to track receivables by client with aging so that w…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given invoice, aging buckets update
  • When overdue, dunning letters auto-trigger
  • When paid, invoice closes
  • Given target DSO, variance is shown
  • Given a tenant with Module 13 enabled, when an authorized Finance Manager performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Finance Manager on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M13-010
P2 8 pts Forecasting Finance Manager

As a Finance Manager, I want revenue forecast by client and contract so that I can predict cash flow.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Billing & Invoicing capability by enabling Finance Managers to revenue forecast by client and contract. It is a P2 priority item sized at 8 story points and scheduled within Phase 4 — Intelligence.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Finance Manager (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 13 — Billing & Invoicing — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Billing & Invoicing → Forecasting
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Finance Manager, I want revenue forecast by client and contract so that I c…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given pipeline and contract, forecast is computed
  • When I adjust assumptions, projections update
  • When I compare to actual, variance highlighted
  • Given export, board pack is ready
  • Given a tenant with Module 13 enabled, when an authorized Finance Manager performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Finance Manager on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage

US-M13-013
P0 5 pts Tax Handling Finance Officer

As a Finance Officer, I want correct VAT and WHT application per invoice so that tax compliance is ensured.

Story Details

Business Context

This story supports Egybell's Billing & Invoicing capability by enabling Finance Officers to correct VAT and WHT application per invoice. It is a P0 priority item sized at 5 story points and scheduled within Phase 4 — Intelligence.

Preconditions

  • User is authenticated via SSO and has a valid Praxion session
  • User has the role permission defined for Finance Officer (or equivalent) on the tenant
  • Tenant has Module 13 — Billing & Invoicing — enabled in the license plan
  • Required master data (departments, cost centers, clients) is already configured
  • Bilingual content (Arabic + English) is available where user-facing
  • For Outsourced-employment contexts, the client assignment is active

Primary Flow

  1. User navigates to Billing & Invoicing → Tax Handling
  2. User initiates the action described in the story (As a Finance Officer, I want correct VAT and WHT application per invoice so that…)
  3. System validates inputs against business rules and bilingual requirements
  4. System persists the change inside the tenant-scoped schema (RLS enforced)
  5. System writes an immutable audit event (actor, action, before/after, timestamp UTC+Cairo)
  6. System dispatches notifications (in-app, email, and — if subscribed — push) to affected parties
  7. User sees confirmation toast and the updated record in the list view

Alternate & Exception Flows

  • Validation error — system highlights offending fields and blocks submission until corrected
  • Permission denied — system returns 403 with remediation guidance and audits the attempt
  • Concurrency conflict — system detects stale version and prompts user to refresh & retry
  • Approval required — record is routed to approver queue and locked for edits until decision
  • Integration failure — system queues the event for retry and alerts Platform Admin after 3 failures
  • Session expired — user is redirected to SSO login with return URL preserved

Detailed Acceptance Criteria

  • Given client and service, tax rate auto-applies
  • When exempt, certificate is stored
  • When WHT, deduction is captured
  • Given filing, VAT return is supported
  • Given a tenant with Module 13 enabled, when an authorized Finance Officer performs the action, then the system completes it within the SLA (p95 < 1.5 s server-side)
  • Given the action is executed, then an audit event with actor, action, timestamp, and before/after payload is persisted and immutable
  • Given the UI is rendered in Arabic, then all labels, placeholders, messages, and dates render RTL with Arabic numerals as per user preference
  • Given the record touches PII, then data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and field-level access is enforced per the Access Matrix
  • Given the user lacks permission, when they attempt the action via UI or API, then the request is rejected with 403 and logged to the security audit
  • Given the action triggers a notification, then recipients receive it via their preferred channel within 60 seconds (email, in-app, push)
  • Given the record is exported, then the export respects field-level masking and includes a watermark with user, timestamp, and tenant
  • Given the action is reversible, then the user can undo it within 15 minutes subject to approval rules

Data Inputs & Validations

  • All mandatory fields must be populated; partial saves allowed only as drafts
  • Bilingual name / title fields require both Arabic and English values
  • Dates must be in ISO-8601 and validated against Egyptian public holidays where relevant
  • Monetary values must include currency (EGP default) and respect tenant precision rules
  • File uploads limited to 25 MB, whitelisted MIME types (pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg, png)
  • National ID, tax number, and social insurance number validated via checksum

Notifications

  • In-app banner to Finance Officer on success/failure
  • Email to approver when action enters the review queue (bilingual template)
  • Push notification (mobile) to affected Outsourced Employee if the action touches their record
  • System event broadcast to Analytics module for reporting
  • Daily digest summary to HR Director covering all changes in this epic

Edge Cases

  • Bulk operation partially fails — system must roll back atomically and show per-row error report
  • User's session role is changed mid-action — system must re-evaluate permission on submit
  • Record is locked by another user — system shows the holder and provides 'request unlock' option
  • Tenant is in read-only maintenance mode — system blocks writes and displays banner
  • Record is part of a sealed payroll period or closed financial period — action blocked with clear message
  • Legal-hold flag is set on employee — deletion blocked regardless of permission
  • Arabic input contains mixed LTR tokens — RTL shaping must still render correctly
  • Clock skew between client and server > 5 minutes — system warns and uses server time

Dependencies

  • M1 Core HRIS — employee master data
  • M10 System Administration — roles, permissions, SSO, feature flags
  • M9 Analytics & Reporting — event stream
  • Notification service — email, in-app, push providers
  • Audit service — append-only store

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance: p95 < 1.5 s for UI actions, p99 < 3 s
  • Availability: 99.9% monthly within business hours (Sun–Thu 08:00–20:00 Cairo)
  • Security: OWASP ASVS L2, PDPL-compliant data handling, per-field encryption for PII
  • Bilingual: 100% string coverage in Arabic + English with RTL layout
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Auditability: every write produces an immutable audit record retained ≥ 7 years
  • Multi-tenancy: row-level security guarantees zero cross-tenant data leakage
